method.time_basis: UTC message timestamps compared with successive main-branch committer timestamps; author timestamps retained separately.
method.temporal_matching: A message is associated with the next commit at or after its timestamp. This is a candidate window, not proof of inclusion or authorship. Post-commit confirmations may fall into the next window. Forks may repeat inherited messages.
method.deduplication: Application and session UUID; exported transcripts and editor snapshots are evidence copies. Delegated sessions retain their parent UUID. OpenClaw native and trajectory exports are merged; nested Codex execution copies are not counted again.
method.model_evidence: Actual Codex turn_context.model, Copilot request modelId, and OpenClaw message.model or trajectory modelId. Model menus, diagnostic probes, auto routing labels and delivery-mirror labels are excluded.
method.privacy: Sanitized technical summaries only. No raw chats, personal conversations, credentials, local absolute paths or agent review reports.
method.source_checksums: SHA-256 and byte lengths identify snapshots read during this audit; active logs can subsequently grow.

limitations: This is an audit of recoverable local stores, not proof that deleted, unsaved, compacted or never-recorded conversations can be reconstructed.
Absence of a session UUID from a commit body does not prove that its reasoning was omitted; several older commit bodies summarize the work without listing sessions.
Hamilton has no recoverable OpenClaw conversations in its local agent store; relevant OpenClaw records were found on Euler.
Three Euler-only Copilot sessions lack model metadata in the recovered records. Available request identifiers on Hamilton supply versions for duplicated sessions.

One additional Hamilton candidate contains damaged JSON/UTF-8. Its intact records were recovered separately and concern unrelated workstation support; it contributes no paper-session or model attribution.
The current session remains in progress after the reference HEAD. Its latest changes need a future commit narrative.
